about.en: RIF is the utility and governance token of the Rootstock ecosystem, Bitcoin's merge-mined EVM-compatible sidechain. It is staked as stRIF to vote and earn rewards in the RootstockCollective DAO and is used to pay for RIF infrastructure services. RIF was issued on Rootstock at 0x2AcC95758f8b5F583470ba265EB685a8F45fC9D5, with bridged versions on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base and Solana.
